title: Big Sister’s Happiness
paragraphs: When the time came, Father, Sakura-chan, Assistant, Rival, and Mole each packed up their things and were about to set off. Of course, I was fully prepared as well.
“Alright, let’s head to the meeting place.”
“Let’s gooo!”
“Motoyasu-kun, where are you going!?”

No one can stop this urge to run! And before I knew it, we arrived at what seemed to be the meeting place—a beach along the coast. It was a little distance away from the port. I could see a few boats here and there. There were also some islands visible in the distance.
“This is where we’re supposed to meet.”
“Naaaoofuuumiii-chaan!”
Older Sister cheerfully called out to Father with lively steps. Oh? Panda is with her too. She already had a ribbon tied around her head.
“Hey, Sadeena-san, Larsa-san. Not feeling hungover, are you? If you are, I can give you some medicine.”
“No problem. I didn’t get to enjoy the drink because I was being teased by you lot.”
“Boss’ swimsuit!”
Panda’s subordinates were gripping the image crystals with bloodshot eyes. Looks like they came prepared. Or rather, she’s really popular.
“Ah, that embarrassed look on Boss’ face… so adorable!”
“Damn, but I have to be grateful to those two.”
“Yeah. As frustrating as it is, I’m willing to let Boss go.”
“You guys! Cut it out!”
Panda was giving her subordinates a knuckle sandwich. What a noisy bunch.
“Why do you guys keep talking about stuff like that?”
Even Father was looking exasperated.
“Seriously… how did I end up involved in such frivolous talk…”
“Oh? But wasn’t it your dream, Sasa-chan? To build a happy family with your husband in a house with a white roof? Of course, that includes dressing up in cute outfits too.”
“W-What!?”
Panda’s voice cracked. Ah, I see. She probably got drunk and spilled the beans to Older Sister.
“Ah, the charm of contrast. But you guys… are you really okay with someone taking Larsa-san away?”
“Boss’ happiness is our happiness!”
“Even if it’s some troublesome person who’s stepped deep into the darkness, as long as they win Boss’ heart, we’ll swallow our tears and accept it!”
“Yes! As long as we can see Boss’ happy smile, that’s enough!”

These guys have such relatable sentiments. When I was chasing after Filo-tan, I met comrades who felt the same way. Wishing for the happiness of someone important is the most natural thing in the world. Of course, I have the confidence, resolve, and determination to make Filo-tan happy.
“You lot… if you don’t knock it off, I’ll kill you.”
Panda was cracking her knuckles with an aura of menace.
“Especially you! The one who said ‘charm of contrast’!”

“Me? Oh, right. On my way back from the market where I was picking up ingredients for the lunch, I found a headband that I thought would suit Larsa-san. You should try it on later. I also got some medicine to soften your fur, so you can start using it tonight.”

Father casually handed various things to Panda. And now, whether out of shock or bewilderment, or maybe her anger had just dissipated, Panda was left staring blankly with wide eyes. Father smiled as he took Panda’s hand.
“Try your best to become a cute mascot, okay? When you’re done, let me give you a hug.”
“Uh…”
Panda, still wide-eyed, was being inspected by Older Sister as she checked her fur.
“Oh my, it’s a bit rough, isn’t it?”
“Yeah.”
“Even if Sasa-chan’s fur is nice, you can’t make these biceps look plush-like. What are we going to do about those muscles?”
“It’s fine. This much is within acceptable limits. Worst case, we can just hide it with the costume. Right, Imiya-chan?”
“Eh? Ah, yes.”
Mole, having understood what Father meant, did a quick spin in front of Panda.
“Gaelion will join too! Na no!”

Rival, not wanting to be outdone, started twirling around and striking poses. You don’t matter at all right now. Anyway, both Mole and Rival were already in swimsuits, looking slightly dressed up. Of course, they would be putting on armor over that later.
“See? If you show a little charm like this, no one will care. Larsa-san, with a bit of charm, could be even cuter than any real panda I know!”
“Sasa-chan, strike a pose so you don’t lose to Imiya-chan and Gaelion-chan. Come on, don’t be shy.”
“O-Oh! —Wait, no!”
Panda was about to comply but slapped away the hands of Father and Older Sister.
“If we’re going out, then hurry up and go! Did you bring me along just to dress me up!?”
“Now that you mention it, you’re right. We’re not trying to do a complete body makeover, but let’s work on making Larsa-san cuter along the way.”
“I’m looking forward to it. The moment Sasa-chan spreads her wings and becomes a butterfly! Anyway, let’s set off and get to know everyone better today!”
And so, with two small boats prepared by Father and Older Sister, we set off to sea. Older Sister immediately transformed into her beast form and began pulling the boat. Such incredible strength.
“Sadeena-san, are you okay?”
“I’m fine.”
“Still, we’re heading out to sea under Sadeena-san’s guidance…”
Father seemed a bit concerned about Older Sister pulling the boat.
“Shall I row with the oars? If I row, it’ll be easy.”
Though if I don’t balance it properly, things could get messy. But it’s better than doing nothing.
“Good idea. Let’s lighten Sadeena-san’s burden a little. I’ll also cast some support magic while we’re at it,” Father spoke with slight concern for Older Sister and Panda.
Ah, I see. He’s probably wondering if it’s okay for Panda to realize he’s a Hero.
“Naofumi, should Sakura help pull the boat? Or should she use magic?”
“If Sakura’s doing it, Gaelion will do it too!”
“Whoa.”
Mole supported Assistant when she almost lost her balance on the boat.
“Well, using wind magic to gain propulsion sounds good, but Sadeena-san, what do you think?”
“It’s fine, as long as you don’t overdo it and cause the boat to capsize. But I’d be happier if you helped pull it along.”
“I’ll do it! This will be good training, right?”
“Indeed! Yuki-chan, do your best!”
“Alright. I’ll cast some support magic.”
With that, Father focused his attention on the magic.
“Liberation Aura!”
To start, he cast a basic support spell on Older Sister without any particular enhancements.
“Oh my~?”
With just that, the speed at which Older Sister pulled the boat increased significantly.
“Next is Yuki-chan.”

Father is still a bit behind when it comes to mastering multi-target spells, so there’s always a risk of failure. If there’s no immediate need to be cautious, he probably intends to cast the spells one by one. However… he whispered the “Liberation” part unusually quietly. What’s going on?
“Here I go!”

Yuki-chan jumped out of the boat and transformed into her Filolial form. She kicked off the water’s surface like a waterfowl and aimed to grab the rope pulled by Older Sister… but instead, she started running on the water.
“Oh my! This is amazing!”
Yuki-chan let out a surprised voice and missed grabbing the rope.
“W-What!?”
Panda and her followers shouted in astonishment. What’s wrong with them? They’ve been surprised over and over again.
“A kid with wings just turned into some strange monster! And now it’s running on the water!”
“Master Motoyasu, are you watching!?”

Yuki-chan, slightly excited, waved her hand toward me. Oh… what a nostalgic sight. It reminds me of when Father was in a good mood, and Filo-tan ran across the sea with his support magic. Yuki-chan looks like she’s having a lot of fun.
“Sasa-chan, you can run on water with magic. What’s so surprising about it?”
Older Sister said while pulling the rope.
“That’s not what I meant! She’s running on the sea purely with her physical abilities!”
Panda pointed at Yuki-chan.
“Ah… yeah, you’re right. Yuki-chan isn’t casting any magic, and I don’t sense any interference aside from my support magic.”
Rather… Father muttered as he watched Yuki-chan with a distant gaze.
“She’s probably stepping forward with her left foot before her right foot sinks, and then stepping with her right foot before her left foot sinks. Amazing.”
“Just how powerful is your support magic!?”
Panda’s sharp retort hit Father perfectly.
“That looks fun! Naofumi, Sakura wants to do that too!”
Sakura-chan was gazing longingly at Yuki-chan running across the water.

“Yuki-chan seems to instinctively know that kicking off the water hard enough produces this effect… It’s amazing. At this rate, she might even be able to run through the air by using the wind as a foothold someday.”
“She can run through the air!? Then cast it on Sakura! I don’t want to lose to Gaelion!”
“Sakura won’t lose!”
“It’s Gaelion’s job to carry Naofumi on his back and fly!”
Assistant let out a sigh, clearly exasperated. By the way… whatever happened to the part where I was supposed to row with the oars?
